info.text:
When you pay with Affirm, the store pays Affirm a fee too.
Store fees (merchant network revenue) were about $1.15B in fiscal 2026, the year to June 30, 2026.
That's about 2.3% of the $50.2B spent through Affirm, per its 10-K.
Affirm's 10-K says stores generally pay bigger fees on 0% APR loans.
Sources: Affirm Form 10-K filings, fiscal 2021-2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
